name: Hello Chengdu
overview: Gloria goes to Chengdu to film a documentary to see through her boyfriend Li Hao's lies. His Agent father Daniel came after him to protect him, and he kept in conflict with Li Hao's assistant Sister Rong. Li Hao awakens during the live broadcast of the anti-counterfeiting campaign, and Sister Rong performs martial arts to relieve the siege. After everyone reconciles, Li Hao becomes a real anchor to promote culture, Gloria documentary becomes popular, and Daniel falls in love with Sister Rong. The story shows Chengdu's inclusiveness and cultural charm, conveying sincerity, communication and family values.
